text:
sara_p: Quick sync — I want to align on a short list of deployment scenarios we include in the private deploy GA. We need clear tradeoffs for customers (network complexity vs. downtime vs. telemetry).

aj_eng: +1. Propose we treat 3 scenarios: 1) VPC single-subnet minimal (fastest install), 2) VPC multi-subnet with control-plane isolation, 3) Air-gapped on-prem. Each has different handshake/handshake-fallback requirements.

lina_se: I like that. Also call out support level per scenario (self-serve, SE-assisted, field-eng). Customers keep asking for upgrade zero-downtime guarantees — we need to set realistic SLAs.

mike_product: Right — let's draft launch gates: must-have: installer idempotency, automated rollback, documented network ports, and KMS integration. Nice-to-have: in-place rolling patch with live KV-cache migration.

chloe_ops: From ops POV, telemetry is tricky. Air-gapped will only support local logs. For VPC we need opt-in telemetry + hashed metrics. We need a minimal telemetry contract.

sara_p: Agreed. Can we enumerate exactly what telemetry fields we need? latency p50/p95, token counts, error rates, model id, and a hashed customer id. Nothing PII.

aj_eng: I'll draft a tiny schema. Example proto/YAML snippet to include in docs:
```yaml
telemetry:
  required:
    - latency_p50
    - latency_p95
    - token_count
    - error_rate
  optional:
    - model_version
    - hashed_customer_id
```
This is implementation-friendly and works offline for air-gapped by writing to a file.

lina_se: Network troubleshooting is another launch gate. We must ship a local diagnostic tool that outputs connectivity checks: DNS, port reachability, certificate chain. Customers expect a single command with clear next steps.

mike_product: For upgrade paths: if a customer is on our earlier package (v1), support an automated migration path that preserves model pins. If migration failure, fallback to previous version within X minutes. We should decide X — ops suggests 5-10 minutes.

chloe_ops: 10 minutes gives us room to run health checks and rollback cleanly via the operator. 5 might be tight for large clusters.

sara_p: Let's tentatively pick 10 min for GA and revisit in post-GA. Add that to release criteria.

aj_eng: One more thing — customer-managed networking. Customers want to inject their own egress/proxy. We need a documented contract for outbound allowlist plus a small set of TLS SNI endpoints. Keep IPs DNS-based, we will provide region-based CNAMEs, not fixed IPs (reduces ops headache).

lina_se: That means we also need a clear fallback when DNS is blocked. Suggest providing an offline bundle including model artifacts + allowed config that supports fully-local inference for gated customers.

chloe_ops: For field readiness, we need runbooks per scenario and a checklist for SEs that includes: pre-install network checklist, preflight diagnostics, upgrade rollback steps, and support escalation matrix.

mike_product: Ok — action items: @aj_eng draft telemetry schema + installer diag tool prototype; @lina_se draft SE checklist and support tiers; @chloe_ops draft runbooks and GA upgrade SLA language. I'll collate and ship a GH draft of the PRD.

aj_eng: Working on telemetry + small CLI today. Pushing a branch by EOD.

lina_se: I'll start the checklist and include 2 customer personas (small infra, enterprise netops).

chloe_ops: I'll draft runbooks and the 10-min rollback flow.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: branch redwood/private-deploy-roadmap -> staging at 2026-04-08T08:30:00Z :rocket:

sara_p: Great progress. Final note: marketing wants clear copy for GA announcing "3 supported private deployment profiles" — but we shouldn't overpromise the air-gapped feature set. We'll call it 'advanced-ops supported'.

aj_eng: Copy that. Will add a short guidance doc for customers: "Which profile is right for you?" with tradeoff table.

sara_p: Thanks all — we'll reconvene next Tue after PRD draft is up. :thumbsup:
